sections.churn_summary: Hold-buffer guards are aligned on the three focus tracks (`exit_confirm_screens=2`, `reentry_cooldown_screens=1`, `min_rebalance_notional_gbp=10.0`), and the latest pass is operationally clean: `buffered_holdings=0`, `duplicate_day_skip=false`, and `buffer_holds_planned=0` / `reentry_skips_planned=0` on rules and ai_judgment. Lifetime decision-review cost drag remains elevated on control and primary (`rules` 0.4539 / 77 trades; `ai_judgment` 0.3941 / 59 trades), with watch alerts, though primary still beats control on `excess_after_costs` (−0.3561 vs −0.4295) and epoch-scoped drag is lower on primary than control (`learning_track_epoch_datum`: ai_judgment epoch `cost_drag` 0.1998 vs rules 0.3002). The 7-day buffered-hold replay supports keeping two confirmation screens: lowering to one adds four simulated trades and about +4.5pp cost drag on both rules and ai_judgment (`trade_count_delta_lower_minus_higher` 4; `cost_drag_delta_lower_minus_higher` 0.0454 / 0.0473). The single biggest operational learning gap is that adjacent buy→sell churn still fired on PAF.L on rules and ai_judgment (`adjacent_flip_count` 1 each) while every track’s exit-shadow cohort has `closed_count` 0, so post-exit grace vs rotation evidence cannot yet inform guard tuning.

sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [paper_churn] Observe-only rebalance-log replay on rules and ai_judgment with `reentry_cooldown_screens`: 2 (forked track config, live unchanged) over the same 7d window as the PAF.L flip — expected learning value: test whether the logged adjacent buy→sell on 2026-09-25 would drop without weakening the kept `exit_confirm_screens=2` verdict from plr-20260901-02.

2. [monitoring] Weekly epoch readout for momentum_grace after the 2026-09-25 apply (`min_conviction` 0.1, `sector_cap` 0.2) — expected learning value: first post-apply comparison of `trade_count` and `cost_drag` vs rules/ai_judgment once `learning_track_epoch_datum` shows `post_apply_trade_count` ≥1 and `equity_marks` ≥2 (currently 0 / false benchmark span).

3. [offline_sim] Archive rebalance replay (L111 scope) for rules and ai_judgment covering epoch starts 2026-08-12 / 2026-08-26 — expected learning value: quantify whether the 7d buffered-hold panel (`log_entries_replayed` 4, `full_exits_in_window` 3) understates churn relative to archive passes, per replay limitations in `buffered_hold_counterfactual`.
